messages:
sre-oncall: alert: na2 apiserver error-rate spike (503s) observed after a large GPU pool scale-up at 14:31 UTC. controller-manager logs show frequent leader renew attempts.
miriam: grabbing dashboard. any NAT/SNAT alerts?
devops-bot: alert: ephemeral_port_exhaustion na2 = 1 (used 16382 / 16384) :rotating_light:
leo: wow that saturated fast. what triggered the scale-up?
owen: looks like scheduled job batch-x launched 600 pods, cluster-autoscaler spawned 120 GPU nodes in ~2m. Many pods created outbound control-plane connections during init.
kate: kube-proxy conntrack metrics high too. sample log: 
```
I0411 14:31:59.456 kube-proxy.go:431] failed to set up proxier: conntrack: table full
```
sre-oncall: chain: rapid scale-up -> massive short-lived kubelet/apiserver connections -> ephemeral port exhaustion + conntrack table full -> apiserver returning 503s under accept queue pressure -> controller-manager keeps retrying leader ops -> brief etcd election jitter.
miriam: etcd endpoints show leader on na2-c-02, follower commit latencies spiked to 200ms during event. etcdctl alarm status none.
leo: can we expand ephemeral port range quickly?
owen: bumping sysctl ephemeral ports and tcp_tw_reuse: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 65000"` and `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1` on NAT gateways. rolling now.
kate: deploying conntrack-tune ds to kube-proxy nodes: `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=400000`.
devops-bot: apply: sysctl changes queued -> rollout in progress :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: I'm going to throttle the autoscaler and add a pod startup smear to avoid concurrent node attach storms. setting cluster-autoscaler flag --scale-down-delay=10m and rate-limit.
miriam: moving etcd leader away from na2-c-02 to na2-a-01 to reduce IO contention; marking na2-c-02 unsched for control-plane traffic.
leo: leader moved, commit latency back to ~35ms. apiserver 5xx rate trending to baseline.
owen: conntrack usage now 18k / 400k, ephemeral ports free. NAT logs show many TIME_WAIT entries from kubelet -> fix reduces churn.
kate: controller-manager restarts stopped, leader election stable.
sre-oncall: follow-ups: 1) add autoscaler preflight to detect bursty pod launches (eval policy), 2) add metric for ephemeral port headroom alert, 3) default conntrack bump for kube-proxy nodes in GPU clusters, 4) add a startup jitter to our batch templates.
miriam: opening incident ticket and scheduling 1hr postmortem. tagging ENG-PLATFORM and COST to discuss expensive burst patterns.
leo: noted customer impact: short-lived API 503s for some orchestration operations; no persistent data loss.
sre-oncall: runbook updates: infra/runbooks/na2-gpu-scale.md draft will include mitigation steps and sysctl toggles.
owen: will also add a canary in the autoscaler to limit max simultaneous node adds to 20 while we iterate.
kate: adding alert threshold: ephemeral ports used > 75% for 3m -> p1.
sre-oncall: monitoring for 45m, will close when stable. thanks all. :thumbsup:
__notes: Single Slack thread in eng-sre about NA region apiserver 503s caused by rapid GPU autoscaler scale-up leading to ephemeral port exhaustion and conntrack pressure; includes mitigation and follow-ups.
